add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

spec2def(dpwsockx.dll dpwsockx.spec)

# dpwsockx.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dpwsockx-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(dpwsockx_shims OBJECT dpwsockx_main.c)
target_link_libraries(dpwsockx_shims PRIVATE wine dxguid uuid oldnames libws2_32 libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(dpwsockx_shims)
add_dependencies(dpwsockx_shims wineheaders)
add_cargo_module(dpwsockx dpwsockx-cargo dpwsockx.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dpwsockx_shims psdk uuid_sources)
